_comment: Hand-maintained. Game updates shipped without their own Steam announcement (so the Steam-news patch detector can't see them). Each entry needs primary sources; published_at = when the build went live on Steam's public branch (api.steamcmd.net depots.branches.public.timeupdated).

lethal-company.label: v81
lethal-company.title: Version 81 (hotfix, announced on Zeekerss' Discord, not on Steam)

sources: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/105600/view/1844751498222763 (State of the Game, Sep 2026: 'lingering fixes that remain from 1.4.5.8'; tModLoader team: 'the 1.4.5.8 hotfix changes')
